Wuldemere
Bridgeport, Connecticut

Mr. Frank Harper, Sec'y.

To Colonel Theodore Roosevelt,
287 4th Ave., New York City.

My dear Sir:-
I am writing you at the suggestion

of Mr. Sanford Stoddard of Bridgeport, and

Mr. McGraw, Sec'y. at the Progressive Head-

guarters in New York, to ask your good offices
in behalf of the Contemporary Club of
Bridgeport, of which I have the honor to be
President,

The Contemporary Club is a literary

club of this City, composed of one hundred and

twentyfive of the leading gentlemen and ladies
